fieldValues.title: Allocate: the right hands pick up ready work
fieldValues.purpose: Ready work reaches the right hands, human or agent, at the right time, and nothing is claimed twice or dropped.
fieldValues.in_scope: Routing by domain to a group, the ready queue, claims, holds, working groups, routines and local sessions.
fieldValues.out_of_scope: How the work is built once claimed (Build).
